endorsements.label: Federal Computer Fraud and Abuse Act .
endorsements.description: Eric Sinrod, partner, Duane, Morris & Heckscher LLP. Federal Computer Fraud and Abuse Act . We are going to discuss the Federal Computer Fraud and Abuse Act and look at how various hacking, virus and denial of service attacks trigger different sections of the Act. We will also discuss how intent and status affect levels of criminal liability. We will further discuss recent Congressional proposals to the amend the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act. Finally, we will look at international efforts to harmonize cyber-crimes laws. See It! Real Media ( surestream video file ) Hear it! Real Audio ( 28k-isdn surestream )
